source.publication: About Wyoming, State of Wyoming official portal (wyo.gov)
source.section: economy paragraph, second sentence: Wyoming has no personal income tax (no state return or form lines exist)

worked: Federal AGI = wages 70,000.00 + interest 1,500.00 = 71,500.00. Federal taxable income = 71,500.00 - 15,750.00 single standard deduction = 55,750.00 (given, not tested). Wyoming imposes no personal income tax, so there is no state return: state taxable income 0.00, tax before credits 0.00, credits 0.00, state income tax 0.00 regardless of income.
